name: check-user-phone-already-registred
description: Verifica se telefone já está cadastrado no firebase authentication

scripts.deploy-cloud-function: cd deploy && gcloud functions deploy checkUserPhoneAlreadyRegistred --gen2 --runtime nodejs22 --max-instances 5 --trigger-http --region southamerica-east1 --allow-unauthenticated --project ${GCP_PROJECT:-corresocialapp} --entry-point checkUserPhoneAlreadyRegistred --service-account fn-check-phone@${GCP_PROJECT:-corresocialapp}.iam.gserviceaccount.com

author: Wellington Souza
